capabilities: Sync Memos notes into year/month folder structures
Download images and attachments to local vault folders
Convert Memos #tag# syntax to Obsidian tags
Generate AI summaries and tag suggestions per memo
Create weekly AI review notes with highlights and statistics
disambiguation: Not related to Obsidian's Sync core feature; it pulls content from the self-hosted Memos service into the vault.
extras: README is bilingual (English/Chinese); Claude support is listed as in development; the author requests donations ('buy me a coffee').
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull Memos content, tags, and attachments into a vault or organize them by date.

relations.evidence: 将 Memos 内容同步到 Obsidian 的插件，提供无缝集成体验。
